title: Davis takes SAP security training; he and Grusch discuss hidden SCIs vs SAPs

tellings.quote: I went through when I was at Erol space I went through special Access program security training

plain: The physicist Eric Davis told the podcast host Jesse Michels that while he worked at the Aerospace Corporation, a defense research company, he went through security training for special access programs, a tightly restricted kind of secret US government project. He says he and David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, have talked about how secrets can be hidden in a different kind of classified category, called sensitive compartmented information, instead of in those programs, which matters to anyone trying to find where UFO secrets might be kept.
